{{Top|leg}}
The '''surveillance upgrade''' was designed for light scout [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other listening models. It gave a slight increase to the droid's espionage skills.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
